figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: An illustration, not a real offer. Offer A is a software engineer package of Rs 14 LPA: Rs 10 lakh fixed, Rs 2 lakh a bonus that may vary and Rs 2 lakh of stock released over four years. Offer B is a data scientist package of Rs 12 LPA, all fixed.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Offer A looks Rs 2 lakh higher, yet its fixed pay is Rs 83,000 a month before tax against Rs 1 lakh a month for Offer B. Compare fixed pay first, then decide how much you trust the bonus and the stock.

blocks.heading: Path Stalls, and Which One Scales Further

items.text: Pick a narrow type of customer, such as clinics, small online shops or coaching centres, and one clear problem.
Start with people you know and ask happy clients for a referral right after a good result.
Put scope, price and a deposit in writing before you start, and price any change request separately.
Watch one number: how many enquiries turn into paid work.
Check GST and Udyam (MSME) registration rules on the official portals once paid work grows, because thresholds change.
Do not depend on one freelance platform.
